gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-mysuru: Heavy, wide-spaced lettering up top, then a contemporary line below. Dogica does commanding best, its lowercase crowding the capitals, while Hind Mysuru does quiet reading best, every a left ajar and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads clean and spacious, its rounded letters leaving generous gaps at every terminal. Yet the real hook is Dogica, heavy and wide-tracked, set against that flat, unswelling line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-huninn: Big, wide-set and unmistakably loud, with a clear opening on every curve. Huninn does the quiet work, its curves matching the stems exactly, while Dogica handles the heavy, commanding voice.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-karla: Karla reads modern and approachable, its tall middle band making each line look stocky. Dogica, meanwhile, does heavy and commanding best, wide-tracked and loud, while Karla keeps the text friendly.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-khula: Modern in manner, Khula carries a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open. And beneath heavy Dogica, paragraphs of Khula would flow smoothly, each line open and unhurried.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-krub: Heavy, wide-tracked and commanding, with lowercase crowding right up to the capitals. Krub does the reading, its curves left unfinished and its x-height pronounced, while Dogica does the shouting.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-kufam: Kufam keeps a single track width like a neon sign tube, with generously open curves in its e. Dogica brings heavy, wide-spaced weight above, and the two never compete.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-mada: Heavy, wide-tracked and commanding, Dogica sets the tone with lowercase that crowds the capitals and curves left open. Mada then keeps paragraphs approachable, its towering midzone carrying the line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-martel-sans: Loud, heavy and widely spaced, with lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Martel Sans then follows with generous curve openings and a high mean line, giving Dogica a quieter partner beneath it.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-montserrat-underlin: Montserrat Underline reads professional and open, its counters breathing like a cut reed. Line after line the marker-like stroke holds steady, round bowls never swelling, while Dogica stays up top, heavy and wide-spaced.
